doctrine: Three-layer operating system for content-driven business: (1) Infrastructure = accounts, security, commerce (setup sequence load-bearing, timezone/currency permanent, 2FA mandatory, Business Portfolio > Facebook Page > Instagram > Ad Account > Commerce Catalog > Meta Pixel); (2) Content Systems = format menu (face-to-camera, voiceover vlog, B-roll+text, tutorial, carousel), content multiplication (1 idea across 3-4 formats), validated content strategy (pool 20+ proven posts, recreate 3x3, analyze top 3, double down), hook layering (text/verbal/visual), value pillars (educational/entertaining/inspirational/relatable), batch production, idea generation (scroll mining, signal mining, performance review), distribution via Meta Business Suite; (3) Messaging = StoryBrand SB7 (customer as hero, brand as guide, external/internal/philosophical problems, 5-second Grunt Test), Jab-Jab-Jab-Right Hook (80/20 value-to-ask ratio), native content per platform, three-layer problem solving (address internal + philosophical not just external). Profile optimization: PBC framework (positioning/branding/clear bio+CTA), unique edge statement, attention-to-revenue funnel (attention > emotion > trust > sale > email > referral). Paid ads only after organic works. Ads Manager over boosting. Conversion campaigns 90% of spend, direct response focus, ROAS measurement. PESO model (paid/earned/shared/owned, owned as foundation). Pre-post checklist: driver/format/hooks/pillar/CTA. Content cadence sustainable minimums: Instagram 3 reels/week, TikTok 3-5/week, YouTube 1 long-form/week. Meta Lead Center free alternative to CRM (Intake > Qualified > In Progress > Converted pipeline). One catalog feeds both Facebook Shop + Instagram Shopping. Security non-negotiables: personal ID verified first, Business Portfolio from verified personal profile, 2FA mandatory, least-privilege team access, domain verification.
gates: Infrastructure must be built before content systems
Content systems must validate before paid ads
All three messaging layers required for conversion
Setup sequence is load-bearing—skip a step and rebuild
Timezone/currency permanent on ad account—verify before creation
Profile Grunt Test: caveman understands offer in 5 seconds
workflows: Day 1: Personal ID verification at facebook.com/id with government ID
Day 2-3: Business Portfolio creation, Facebook Page, Instagram connection, 2FA
Day 3-4: Ad account creation (verify timezone/currency), payment method
Day 5-7: Commerce Manager, product catalog, initial products
Week 2: Customize shop, shipping/returns, Instagram Shopping
Week 3: Content distribution, Lead Center activation, first ad campaign
Content multiplication: 1 idea matched against 3-4 formats = week of content
Validated content strategy: pool 20+ proven posts > select 3 formats > create 9 posts > analyze top 3 > double down
Timed scroll mining: 15-20 min intentional scroll for audio trends, format structures, templates
Batch production: plan > film > edit in separate sessions to avoid context-switching
Pre-post filter: run 5-question checklist (driver/format/hooks/pillar/CTA) before creation
Marketing message checklist: 7 questions (hero/want/problem/help/CTA/success/failure) for every asset
Lead Center pipeline review: weekly check for stalled leads, re-engage or remove
prompts: What business driver does this post serve: Revenue, Email List, Audience Nurture, or Creative Expression?
What is the text hook, verbal hook, and visual hook?
Does the content match the native language of the platform?
Does the caveman understand the offer in 5 seconds?
What specific action should the viewer take?
Can this be formatted in 3-4 different ways from one core idea?
Which of the four value pillars does this address: educational, entertaining, inspirational, relatable?
Have I addressed all three problem layers: external, internal, philosophical?
Is this 80/20 value-to-ask or am I overselling?
tools: Ads Manager (conversion campaigns, direct response objective)
Lead Center (free CRM inside Business Suite)
Meta Business Suite scheduler (organic content distribution)
Instagram Insights (performance filtering by follows gained, not views)
operating_rules: Setup sequence is load-bearing; out-of-order setup creates fragmented assets and ban risk
Timezone and currency on ad accounts are permanent; cannot be changed after creation
One catalog feeds both Facebook Shop and Instagram Shopping; one update propagates everywhere
Lead Center pipeline: Intake > Qualified > In Progress > Converted (customizable stages)
Content multiplication: match 1 idea against 3-4 formats for 3-4x output from single concept
Validated content strategy metric: sort by follows gained, not views (follows = growth, views = vanity)
Hook layering: text + verbal + visual must all work simultaneously
Value pillars: rotate across educational/entertaining/inspirational/relatable to prevent fatigue
Batch production: plan/film/edit in separate sessions to eliminate context-switching overhead
Idea generation: timed scroll mining (15-20 min), audience signal mining (DMs/comments), performance review
Profile conversion test: PBC framework (positioning + branding + clear bio+CTA)
Unique edge statement: 'I help [audience] achieve [result] through [method/timeframe]'
Attention-to-revenue funnel: attention > emotion > trust > sale > email capture > referral loop
Don't spend on ads until organic converts; ads amplify what already works, don't fix what doesn't
Ads Manager over boosted posts: set clear objective, full placements/targeting, measure ROAS
90% of ad spend: direct response (download/message/book/buy); brand awareness for billion-dollar companies only
PESO model: paid + earned + shared + owned (owned media is foundation)
StoryBrand SB7: customer = hero, brand = guide; answer 3 questions in 5 seconds
Three-layer problem: address external (obvious), internal (emotional), philosophical (why it matters)
Jab-Jab-Jab-Right Hook: 80% value content, 20% sales asks; marketing should feel like entertainment not advertising
Native content principle: one idea, customized execution per platform; context > content
Meta Lead Center: free CRM alternative if leads come via DM/Messenger; evaluate before paid CRM
Product listings: treat as sales pages; descriptive titles, feature/benefit descriptions, multi-angle images, current inventory
Posting cadence baseline: what you sustain for 52 weeks straight, not aspirational target
Instagram: 3 reels/week on fixed days (M/W/F) + open days for trends
TikTok: 3-5 posts/week cross-posted from IG with platform tweaks
YouTube: 1 long-form/week; package every Reel as YouTube Short for incremental reach
Security: personal ID verified first, Business Portfolio from verified profile, 2FA on Everyone, least-privilege team access, domain verification
All team members: default to employee role, admin only when specifically required
content_ideas: Face-to-camera format: tips, opinions, personal stories, direct address delivery
Voiceover vlog: scripted narration over curated B-roll for storytelling/lifestyle
B-roll+text: 7-15 sec aesthetic clips with text overlay + trending audio for quick tips
Tutorial/demo: step-by-step walkthrough with screen/demo footage for how-tos
Carousel: multi-slide posts for listicles, multi-point arguments, screenshot stories
Content pool method: save 20+ 1M+ view posts in niche, study hook/audio/format patterns
Audience signal mining: review DMs and comments for frequently asked questions
Performance-filtered review: analyze past content by follows gained (not views) to reverse-engineer winners
Idea bank on phone: persistent capture for consistent generation over quality of single idea
weird_gold: Meta has a free CRM (Lead Center) nobody uses; might eliminate need for paid CRM if leads come via DM/Messenger
Instagram profile name field (not username) is searchable for SEO; include keywords audience searches for
Critical metric distinction: Instagram Insights metric toggle from 'views' to 'follows' changes everything; high reach + zero follows = no growth
Boosted posts trap: spending money without thinking (no clear objective, limited targeting, restricted placements)
Batching workflow insight: context-switching overhead so high that plan/film/edit in separate sessions > daily creation
Hook layering discovery: most creators think one layer; actually three (text/verbal/visual) must work simultaneously
Value pillar rotation prevents content fatigue; locking one pillar for months is common failure mode
BrandScript reveals customer transformation (uncertain > confident) as the real success metric, not feature list
Platform-native principle: copy-pasting content everywhere = underperformance vs. mediocre idea adapted natively
Caveman Test as clarity bar: if caveman can't understand in 5 seconds, you lose
